title: Infant Car Seats Recalled by Britax Due to Laceration and Choking Hazards
summary: The harness chest clip can break and pose a laceration hazard. Due to its small size it also poses a choking hazard. Units: About 23,000.

title: Haier America Recalls Chest Freezers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: A capacitor in the freezer's circuitry can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 67,500.

title: Hunter Safety System Recalls Carabiners Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The pins in the carabiners can detach, causing a climbing strap to break free from the safety harness. This can result in the climber falling. Units: About 16,000.

title: BRP Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Explosion Hazard
summary: Electrostatic changes can accumulate and spark in the fuel tank when the engine is left idling, posing an explosion hazard that could result in serious injuries or death. Units: About 1,000.

title: Children's Hooded Jackets and Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled By VOS Sports Due To Strangulation Hazard
summary: The children's hooded sweatshirts have a drawstring through the hood and/or waist that can pose a strangulation or entrapment hazard to children. Units: About 11,700.

title: Full Speed Ahead Crank Sets Used By Numerous Bicycle Manufacturers Recalled Due To Crash Hazard
summary: If the fixing bolt is over-tightened on the non-drive crank arm, the bolt shoulder can crack or break. If this occurs, the non-drive arm can fall off the bicycle causing the rider to crash and suffer injuries. Units: About 9,300.

title: Motorized Awnings Recalled by Somfy Systems Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The awning motor's power cable can be severed while the awning is opened or closed manually, posing a risk of electrical shock to the user. Units: About 4,600.

title: Sportcraft Recalls Pogo Sticks Sold Exclusively at The Sports Authority Due to Risk of Serious Injury
summary: The aluminum rivets on the pogo stick's frame tubes can break and cause the support clamp to detach and release the spring, posing fall and laceration hazards to consumers. Units: About 3,100.

title: Beman Recalls Bowhunting Arrows; Arrows Can Break and Hit Unintended Targets
summary: The recalled arrows can break when launched and hit unintended targets, posing a puncture hazard to the user and bystanders. Units: About 11,300.

title: Mini Tillers with Honda Engines Recalled Due to Fire Hazard
summary: A rubber grommet that is part of the engine's fuel tank can crack and leak fuel, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 6,150.

title: Giant Recalls Anthem X 29er Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The frame can crack at the junction of the seat post and top tube, posing a fall hazard to riders. Units: About 370.

title: Pottery Barn Recalls Lamps Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The electrical wire that runs through the lamps can be pinched or severed at the lamp's adjustable joint, posing a risk of electric shock to consumers. Units: About 7,300.

title: Big Ideas Marketing Recalls to Repair Horse-on-a-Stick Toys Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The reins on horse-on-a-stick toy's bridle are long enough to form a loop around a child's head and neck, posing a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 8,800.

title: Rocking Horse Depot Recalls to Repair Rocking Horse Toys Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The reins on the rocking horse bridle are long enough to form a loop around a child's head and neck, posing a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 1,200.

title: Strangulation Death of a Child Prompts Recall of Roman Shades, Roll-Up Blinds, and Roller Blinds by Hanover Direct/Domestications
summary: Roman Shades: Strangulations can occur when a child places his/her neck between the exposed inner cord and the fabric on the backside of the blind or when a child pulls the cord out and wraps it around his/her neck. title: Club Car Recalls Golf Cars and Hospitality, Utility and Transport Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The brake pedal can crack and separate, resulting in a loss of braking ability. This can result in a crash. Units: About 5,000.

title: Rollerblade USA Recalls to Repair Inline Skates Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The frame mounting bolts and wheel axle bolts can be loose on new skates. Loose wheels or frames on the skates can cause the rider to fall, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 29,000 pairs.

title: Cub Cadet Recalls Utility Vehicles Due to Risk of Loss of Control
summary: The front lower ball joint can detach and cause a loss of steering control. This poses a crash hazard for consumers. Units: About 200.

title: L.L.Bean Recalls Folding Camp Rockers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The plastic anchors attaching the fabric seat back to the frame can break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,300.

title: Meijer Recalls Oscillating Ceramic Heaters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The oscillating mechanism in the heaters can short out, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,700.

title: Metallic Taper Candles Sold Exclusively at Yankee Candle Stores Recalled by General Wax & Candle Company Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The metallic paint can ignite on the candles, posing a risk of fire. Units: About 33,000.

title: Robert Bosch Tool Corp. Recalls Bosch Hammer Drills Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: The models have a grounding system and trigger switch that could cause ground wire abrasion and/or ground connector failure posing a shock hazard. In addition, the switch trigger could become stuck in the "on" position posing an injury hazard to the user. Units: About 20,000 units.

title: Stainless Steel Carafes Recalled by J & H International Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The handle can come loose from the body of the carafe and cause liquid to spill, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 36,000 units.

title: Bassettbaby Recalls to Repair Drop-Side Cribs Due to Entrapment, Suffocation and Fall Hazards
summary: The crib's drop-side rail can malfunction, detach or otherwise fail, causing part of the drop side to detach from the crib. title: Camping Stoves and Equipment Recalled by Katadyn North America Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Damaged fuel lines and/or O-rings may cause fuel leakage, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 5,300 in the United States and 2,400 in Canada.
